parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels joined together.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and defines the overall shape of the cabinet, holding all other parts in place.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports the entire cabinet assembly.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood for stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures balance on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is an internal horizontal board made of MDF, used for dividing storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage levels inside the cabinet for organizing items.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but not designed for frequent movement.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a hinged panel made of MDF with a smooth laminate surface.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a hinged MDF panel with a laminate finish matching the left door.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the right side of the cabinet’s internal storage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding storage compartment made of plywood with a metal handle.
parts.Functional_description: It provides easy-access storage for smaller items and utensils.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally in and out along metal tracks.
